Armadillo.headline: My Tush Hurts benches 62.4 points and still spanks Waddlin to london
paragraphs: Argrider beat xovsa0989 140.1 to 108.06, a 32.04-point win that moves My Tush Hurts to 4-1 and keeps it second in the power rankings at 69-26 all-play. Jaylen Warren went for 36.8, Jaxon Smith-Njigba for 22.8 and Braelon Allen for 17.6. Then there is the bench: Isaiah Likely with 32.4, Jayden Daniels with 32.26, and 62.4 points left there in all, the most in either conference. Harold Fannin started for 1.4 and the Eagles defense for 7.0. The tush got away with it only because the other side was sitting on its own.

xovsa0989 started Brock Purdy for 17.16 and left Drake Maye on the bench with 39.46, a 22.3-point quarterback decision. Add it back and Waddlin to london gets to 130.36, still 9.74 short, so this loss was earned the honest way. Tee Higgins scored 4.2, RJ Harvey 0.7, and the Texans defense sat on the bench with 16.0. Sam LaPorta's 19.8 led the team, and that is how you end up 3-2.
Both teams left a fortune on the bench. Only one of them could afford it.

Juravieal beat YukonMike 165.12 to 128.7 by 36.42 behind Jahmyr Gibbs at 37.7, Parker Washington at 30.4 and the kicker, Jason Myers, at 23.0. Tyler Shough started and scored 1.84, Dohnte Meyers added 3.2, and the Phyrexian Dreadnoughts won by 36.42 anyway. That is 3-2 and sixth in the power rankings at 60-35.

YukonMike was unbeaten coming in and leaves 4-1, third in the power rankings at 68-27. Josh Allen put up 31.5 and Mike Evans 26.3, but Romeo Doubs scored 2.6 and the Raiders defense scored 0.0. There was nothing to fix it with either: 4.0 points left on the bench, Matt Gay's 6.0 the best of a sad little group.
The Phyrexian Dreadnoughts started a 1.84 and still sank Team YukonMike.

Rowdy0991 beat queens22 142.64 to 119.54 by 23.1 behind Puka Nacua's 37.7, Jared Goff's 27.94 and Derrick Henry's 21.0. Mayfield Of Dreams got 1.0 from the Steelers defense and 0.0 from Roman Wilson, kept Matthew Stafford's 27.32 on the bench, and won comfortably anyway. Built with Goff, and they came.

queens22 is 3-2 and 11th in the power rankings at 49-46. Garrett Wilson scored 23.4, Trey McBride 21.6 and Christian McCaffrey 17.3, and then Deebo Samuel scored 1.5 and the Jaguars defense 2.0. Trevor Lawrence's 20.74 and Kyle Pitts' 15.2 sat on a bench that left 19.8 points, 3.3 short of the margin.
Mayfield Of Dreams has no Mayfield, and against Team queens22 it did not need one.

cartercole finally won, 145.4 to 142.8, the closest win in either conference at 2.6. Tate Dogg and Warren T got 31.5 from Bucky Irving, 22.0 from Aaron Rodgers and 21.4 from Tyler Warren, so at least half the team name showed up. Carnell Tate sat on the bench with 1.6 while TreVeyon Henderson started for 4.8, which was, for the record, the correct call. The record is 1-4, 17th in the power rankings at 32-63.

kbartelt07 lost by 2.6 with the Patriots defense scoring 8.0 on the bench while the Bears defense started for 2.0. That 6.0-point swap turns 142.8 into 148.8, a win. Christian Watson's 32.3, Malik Nabers' 29.1 and Joe Burrow's 24.6 deserved better than Rome Odunze's 4.0 and a defense picked from the wrong side of a coin flip. I didn't hear no bell is 2-3 and heard it just fine.
Tate Dogg and Warren T got the Warren and the W. kbartelt07 got the Bears.

lowkeyeastt beat Thomasg2488 135.82 to 104.74 by 31.08 with Davante Adams at 22.1, the kicker Spencer Shrader at 21.0 and Matthew Golden at 20.3. Wide Receivers Galore had a kicker as its second-best starter and another kicker, Ka'imi Fairbairn, on the bench with 17.0. Keon Coleman scored 7.7 and Colston Loveland 3.9. The record is 2-3, and the galore is mostly kickers.

Thomasg2488 stays winless at 0-5 and last of 20 in the power rankings at 10-85 all-play. George Pickens scored 28.0, C.J. Stroud 19.94 and Emeka Egbuka 17.2, and then Saquon Barkley and Harrison Butker both scored 0.0. Patrick Mahomes sat on the bench with 0.0 too, so even the backup plan was empty.
Wide Receivers Galore won with a kicker. Team Thomasg2488 lost with two zeros.

Grizzly.headline: Certified Coke Head outdeals The Nabers Cook Dope by 4.08 points
paragraphs: chookonthecoast beat thatguyPegleg 156.4 to 152.32, a 4.08-point win in the most narcotic matchup the Grizzly can offer. Josh Allen scored 31.5, George Pickens 28.0 and the 49ers defense 20.0, which covered TreVeyon Henderson's 4.8 and Jordan Addison's 0.0. Certified Coke Head is 3-2, fourth in the power rankings at 66-29, and left 0.0 points on the bench. Every bump got used.

thatguyPegleg scored 152.32, the best score in a loss in either conference, and also left 0.0 on the bench. Malik Nabers had 29.1, Garrett Wilson 23.4 and Tyler Warren 21.4. The killers were Brandon Aubrey's 5.0 and the Steelers defense's 1.0 in a game decided by 4.08. The Nabers Cook Dope is 3-2 and 12th in the power rankings at 47-48, which is exactly what a coin-flip all-play looks like.
Two dealers, one corner, and Certified Coke Head had the purer stuff by 4.08.

ArmedRodgery21 beat vpettijohnjr 152.94 to 137.76 by 15.18 and is 5-0, first in the power rankings at 71-24 and the only unbeaten team in either conference. This was a meeting of the two longest losing streaks in conference history, ArmedRodgery21's 13 games and vpettijohnjr's 12, and the record holder is now the last undefeated team standing. Christian Watson scored 32.3, Jared Goff 27.94 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba 22.8. Luck says 1.26 wins above expected, the most in either conference, but 5-0 is 5-0.

vpettijohnjr got 36.8 from Jaylen Warren and 26.28 from Jacoby Brissett, then T.J. Hockenson started for 1.7 and the Raiders defense for 0.0. Even if Blake Corum's 16.2 off the bench had replaced Hockenson, that is 14.5 points back, 0.68 short. Medicaid's Most Wanted is 2-3 and 15th in the power rankings at 37-58.
The 13-game losing streak record holder is the last unbeaten team in APFN. Character development.

seachicken22 won 88.7 to 82.56 in the lowest-scoring game in either conference, a 6.14-point win where the best player was the kicker, Will Reichard, at 16.0. Emanuel Wilson scored 12.2, Jonathan Taylor 11.2 and Carnell Tate 1.6. Team seachicken22 is 3-2 and 16th in the power rankings at 35-60, with 1.16 wins of luck doing the heavy lifting.

adamgum posted the low score in either conference, 82.56, with Malik Washington scoring 12.1 on the bench while Deebo Samuel started for 1.5. That 10.6-point swap makes it 93.16, which wins. David Montgomery added 1.1 for good measure, and Team adamgum left 20.9 points on the bench in a game lost by 6.14.
88.7 beat 82.56. Somebody had to win, and that is the nicest thing anyone will say about it.

Dfiasco0 scored 216.54, the high score in either conference, the biggest blowout at 67.0, and the third-highest conference score since 2021, 1.36 behind TheBread's 217.9 and 16.56 behind Jessicoot's 233.1. Jahmyr Gibbs went for 37.7, Isaiah Likely for 32.4 and Mike Evans for 26.3, and the second-worst starter was a Vikings defense with 11.0. Second place all-time was sitting right there: Rhamondre Stevenson scored 17.5 on the bench while Quinshon Judkins started for 8.0, and that swap makes it 226.04. Little Giants settles for third and a 3-2 record, fifth in the power rankings at 62-33.

Ghaztyz scored 149.54 and lost by 67.0. Puka Nacua went for 37.7, Brock Bowers 22.0 and Spencer Shrader 21.0, while Alvin Kamara scored 2.6 and RJ Harvey 0.7. Kraftin' Lamars is 2-3, 18th in the power rankings at 29-66, and no lineup on earth saves this one.
Little Giants put up 216.54 and still left second place all-time on the bench.

IronMike1987 beat kingruddofrock 143.5 to 139.56 by 3.94 behind Bucky Irving's 31.5, Joe Burrow's 24.6 and Sam LaPorta's 19.8. CeeDee Lamb started for 2.9 and Brian Thomas for 0.0, and Matthew Stafford outscored Burrow from the bench with 27.32. Team IronMike1987 is 2-3, ninth in the power rankings at 54-41.

kingruddofrock stays winless at 0-5, 19th in the power rankings at 20-75, and this one stings. Drake Maye scored 39.46, the best of any starter in the game, and Parker Washington added 30.4, but Mack Hollins started for 0.0 while Courtland Sutton scored 9.8 on the bench. That swap makes it 149.36, a win. With luck at minus 1.05 wins, the worst in either conference, Maye I See Dem TD's? can see everything except a W.
Maye I See Dem TD's? Yes. Maye I see a win? Ask Mack Hollins.

Robber.headline: queens22 beats Dfiasco0 and can now steal the league's best steal
paragraphs: queens22 beat Dfiasco0 186.14 to 142.56 by 43.58 and is 4-1, second in the power rankings at 32-13. Puka Nacua, the week 2 steal from vpettijohnjr, scored 37.7 and is up to 65.4 points since the heist, 14.1 better than Mike Evans. Bucky Irving added 31.5, the same Bucky Irving that adamgum released to make room for Aaron Jones, and Garrett Wilson put up 23.4. Cam Skattebo, whom Dfiasco0 dropped for Derrick Henry, started for 7.1. Team queens22 is a thrift store of other people's discards, and it just beat one of the donors.

Dfiasco0's top scorer was the kicker, Jason Myers, at 23.0, with Trey McBride at 21.6 and Derrick Henry at 21.0. Jayden Daniels scored 32.26 on the bench. Hide Your Players has stolen three times, been robbed once, and sits at plus 53.5 on the steal balance, the best in the league. Now queens22 picks from Bijan Robinson, Brock Purdy, Derrick Henry and Nico Collins, and Bijan is the steal that built that balance: 89.9 points for Dfiasco0 since being taken from Juravieal in week 1. Henry, taken from thatguyPegleg after week 4, could be on the move again after one week.
Hide Your Players. Dfiasco0 didn't hide Bijan, and queens22 is coming for him.

Ghaztyz beat Juravieal 227.44 to 119.2, a 108.24-point massacre and the biggest margin anywhere in APFN this week. Jahmyr Gibbs, stolen from ArmedRodgery21 after week 3, scored 37.7 and is now 53.4 points better than Saquon Barkley since the swap, the best net of any steal in the league. Jaylen Warren added 36.8 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba, last week's steal from queens22, 22.8. The worst non-defense starter was Kyren Williams at 19.6. LaPorta potty is 4-1 and first in the power rankings at 34-11, and the 227.44 beats every conference score this week, though the Robber League does not count for the record books.

Juravieal got 24.6 from Joe Burrow, 23.0 from Brock Bowers and 18.8 from Drake London, then CeeDee Lamb, the week 3 steal from cartercole, started for 2.9. Lamb is now just 4.0 points better than Emanuel Wilson since the swap. Collectible Cardigans has been robbed twice and sits at minus 115.4, and Ghaztyz now picks from Brock Bowers, Caleb Williams, CeeDee Lamb and Patrick Mahomes. Taking Lamb would make him stolen goods twice over.
LaPorta potty flushed Collectible Cardigans by 108.24, and now it gets to go through the closet.

kbartelt07 beat ArmedRodgery21 156.82 to 149.5 by 7.32 with stolen goods doing the work. Malik Nabers, last week's steal from cartercole, scored 29.1 and is 11.9 better than Emeka Egbuka. George Pickens, taken from adamgum after week 3, added 28.0 and is 37.5 points to the good since. Jared Goff had 28.94. Rashee's Lambo benched Rashee Rice, who scored 0.0 anyway, and is 4-1, fifth in the power rankings at 25-20 with 1.22 wins of luck in the trunk.

ArmedRodgery21 is 5-0 in the Grizzly and 2-3 here, third in the power rankings at 31-14 with luck at minus 1.44 wins, the worst in the league. Christian Watson scored 32.3 and Josh Allen 31.5, but Matt Gay kicked 5.0, Dalton Kincaid scored 3.7, and the bench was empty. Already robbed of Jahmyr Gibbs and Jonathan Taylor, ArmedRodgery21 now watches kbartelt07 pick from Josh Allen, Christian Watson, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Zay Flowers. Amon-Ra has been stolen twice, from Ghaztyz and then from cartercole, and could be packing for a third trip.
Rashee's Lambo runs on stolen parts, and Team ArmedRodgery21 is about to donate another one.

adamgum beat thatguyPegleg 114.92 to 100.24 by 14.68. Tyler Warren scored 21.4, Matthew Golden, released by Ghaztyz to make room for Ja'Marr Chase, scored 20.3, and Aaron Jones 18.7. Jones was stolen from vpettijohnjr after week 4 at the cost of releasing Bucky Irving, who scored 31.5 for queens22 this week, so that steal is minus 12.8 so far. Reaper25 is 3-2 on a 15-30 all-play record, with 1.33 wins of luck, the most in the league.

thatguyPegleg went 0-3 across APFN this week, and this was the low point. Parker Washington put up 30.4, and the next two best were the Broncos defense at 15.0 and the kicker Tyler Loop at 14.0. T.J. Hockenson scored 1.7 and RJ Harvey 0.7. Already robbed three times for minus 63.2, thatguyPegleg now watches adamgum pick from Chris Olave, Tyler Shough, Parker Washington and Jaxson Dart.
Reaper25 is 3-2 on 15-30 all-play. The Reaper does not do math.

cartercole beat vpettijohnjr 107.1 to 95.08 by 12.02 and went 3-0 across APFN this week, the only manager to do it. Mike Evans, released by queens22 for Puka Nacua, scored 26.3, the Texans defense 16.0 and Kyle Pitts 15.2. Jeremiyah Love, released by queens22 for De'Von Achane, started for 2.2. Jeantyfied Naberhood lost Malik Nabers to kbartelt07 last week, so it is a Naberhood with no Nabers, but it is 2-3.

vpettijohnjr is 0-5, the only winless team in the Robber League, and 0-3 across APFN this week. Jacoby Brissett scored 26.28 and the kicker Will Reichard 16.0, then Alvin Kamara started for 2.6 and the Raiders defense for 0.0. Pukkake has been robbed four times without a single steal, for a net of minus 205.6, 70.7 worse than anyone else, and cartercole now picks from Jacoby Brissett, Denzel Boston, Will Reichard and Juwan Johnson.
Pukkake keeps getting passed around, and cartercole is next in line.

Steal scoreboard: Dfiasco0's Bijan Robinson, taken from Juravieal in week 1, has the most points of any steal at 89.9, and Ghaztyz's Jahmyr Gibbs has the best net at 53.4 over Saquon Barkley. The worst is queens22's De'Von Achane at minus 15.4 against Jeremiyah Love, with adamgum's Aaron Jones next at minus 12.8.

League.headline: ArmedRodgery21 wins the game of the week because Argrider's best two players were sitting down
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 beat Argrider 152.94 to 140.1 in the game of the week, a 12.84-point win built on Christian Watson's 32.3, Jared Goff's 27.94 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 22.8. Both teams got 22.8 from Smith-Njigba, so that one was a wash. Chase Brown started for 6.0, the Jaguars defense for 2.0, and Dak Prescott's 14.64 watched from the bench. None of it mattered, because the other lineup in this game was doing something much dumber.

Argrider left 62.4 points on the bench, the most in either conference. Isaiah Likely scored 32.4 back there while Harold Fannin started and scored 1.4, a 31.0-point swap that turns 140.1 into 171.1 and this loss into a win. Jayden Daniels kept Likely company with 32.26. My Tush Hurts, mostly from sitting on its best players.
ArmedRodgery21 played the hand it was dealt. Argrider folded with aces on the bench.

xovsa0989 beat adamgum 108.06 to 82.56 by 25.5 with Drake Maye scoring 39.46 on the bench while Brock Purdy started for 17.16. Waddlin to london started the Drake in its name, got 18.8 from him, benched the Drake who actually went off, and still won, because adamgum's 82.56 was the lowest score in either conference. Deebo Samuel started for 1.5 and David Montgomery for 1.1.
adamgum brought 82.56 to a cross-conference game and got waddled by a team playing with its best quarterback on the bench.

Dfiasco0 dropped 216.54 on queens22 and won by 97.0, the high score in either conference and the third-highest in conference history. Jahmyr Gibbs went for 37.7, Isaiah Likely for 32.4 and Mike Evans for 26.3. Yes, the same Isaiah Likely that Argrider left on the bench.

queens22 managed 119.54, with Garrett Wilson at 23.4 and Trey McBride at 21.6, then the Jaguars defense at 2.0 and Deebo Samuel at 1.5. Trevor Lawrence's 20.74 and Kyle Pitts' 15.2 were on a bench that left 19.8 points, which is 77.2 short of mattering.
Little Giants stepped on Team queens22 and did not even feel it.

Juravieal beat thatguyPegleg 165.12 to 152.32 by 12.8 with Jahmyr Gibbs at 37.7, Parker Washington at 30.4 and the kicker Jason Myers at 23.0. Tyler Shough started and scored 1.84, and it did not matter.

thatguyPegleg scored 152.32, the best score in a loss in either conference, and lost with it twice: here and to chookonthecoast in the Grizzly. Malik Nabers had 29.1, Garrett Wilson 23.4 and Tyler Warren 21.4, and there was 0.0 left on the bench to blame.
Juravieal spotted thatguyPegleg a 1.84-point starter and won anyway.
kingruddofrock is winless in the Grizzly at 0-5 and won this one, 139.56 to 128.7 over YukonMike, by 10.86. Drake Maye saw plenty of dem TDs with 39.46, and Parker Washington added 30.4.

YukonMike lost twice this week with the same 128.7, here and to Juravieal in the Armadillo. Josh Allen scored 31.5 and Mike Evans 26.3, but the Raiders defense put up 0.0 and Romeo Doubs 2.6, and only 4.0 points sat on the bench to fix anything.
Maye I See Dem TD's? YukonMike saw all 39.46 of them.

Rowdy0991 beat seachicken22 142.64 to 88.7, a 53.94-point blowout, behind Puka Nacua's 37.7, Jared Goff's 27.94 and Derrick Henry's 21.0. Mayfield Of Dreams ran on Goff and kept Matthew Stafford's 27.32 on the bench.

seachicken22's best starter was the kicker, Will Reichard, at 16.0, with Emanuel Wilson at 12.2 and Jonathan Taylor at 11.2 behind him. That 88.7 somehow won the Grizzly game against adamgum. It did not win this one.
Team seachicken22 brought a kicker-led offense to a Puka fight.

chookonthecoast beat lowkeyeastt 156.4 to 135.82 by 20.58 for a perfect week, with Josh Allen at 31.5, George Pickens at 28.0 and the 49ers defense at 20.0. Jordan Addison started for 0.0 and the bench left 0.0, so Certified Coke Head used every gram.

lowkeyeastt's top three were Davante Adams at 22.1, the kicker Spencer Shrader at 21.0 and Matthew Golden at 20.3, with another kicker, Ka'imi Fairbairn, on the bench at 17.0. Wide Receivers Galore, now featuring kickers galore.
Certified Coke Head cut it with nothing. Wide Receivers Galore cut it with kickers.

IronMike1987 beat kbartelt07 143.5 to 142.8, by 0.7, the closest game anywhere in APFN this week. Bucky Irving went for 31.5, Joe Burrow for 24.6 and Sam LaPorta for 19.8, which covered CeeDee Lamb's 2.9 and Brian Thomas' 0.0. Matthew Stafford outscored Burrow from the bench, 27.32 to 24.6, and it cost nothing.

kbartelt07 lost by 0.7 here and by 2.6 to cartercole in the Armadillo, both with the same 142.8, and both with the Patriots defense scoring 8.0 on the bench while the Bears defense started for 2.0. That 6.0-point swap makes it 148.8, which wins both games. Two losses by a combined 3.3 points, both handed over by the defense on the bench.
Lost by 0.7 with 8.0 on the bench. kbartelt07 definitely heard the bell this time.

cartercole beat vpettijohnjr 145.4 to 137.76 by 7.64, the same 145.4 that won the Armadillo game, behind Bucky Irving's 31.5, Aaron Rodgers' 22.0 and Tyler Warren's 21.4. A Tyler Warren who shows up is the whole point of a team called Tate Dogg and Warren T.

vpettijohnjr got 36.8 from Jaylen Warren and 26.28 from Jacoby Brissett, then T.J. Hockenson started for 1.7 and the Raiders defense for 0.0. Two losses with 137.76 this week, and both times the Raiders defense delivered a clean zero.
Warren against Warren, and the one in the team name won.

Ghaztyz beat Thomasg2488 149.54 to 104.74 by 44.8. Puka Nacua had 37.7, Brock Bowers 22.0 and Spencer Shrader 21.0, enough to cover Alvin Kamara's 2.6 and RJ Harvey's 0.7. Kraftin' Lamars lost the Grizzly game by 67.0 with this exact score and turned around to win this one by 44.8.

Thomasg2488 is 0-5 and last of 20 in the power rankings at 10-85 all-play. Saquon Barkley started for 0.0, Harrison Butker kicked his way to 0.0, and George Pickens' 28.0 was the only thing that really worked. Team Thomasg2488 left 0.0 points on the bench, so there was not even a lineup mistake to complain about.
Thomasg2488 set the optimal lineup, and it still had two zeros in it.

Across conference and league games, seven managers went 2-0 this week: ArmedRodgery21, Dfiasco0, IronMike1987, Juravieal, Rowdy0991, chookonthecoast and cartercole. Seven went 0-2: queens22, kbartelt07, Thomasg2488, YukonMike, thatguyPegleg, vpettijohnjr and adamgum.
